entities.name: White mana
entities.description: One of the five colors of mana, drawn from plains and embodying morality, order, peace and community above the individual.

entities.name: Green mana
entities.description: The color allied with white against black; values life, harmony and instinct.

entities.name: Blue mana
entities.description: The color allied with white against red; values thought, planning and knowledge.

entities.name: Red mana
entities.description: An enemy color of white that values freedom, emotion and striking without warning.

entities.name: Black mana
entities.description: The chief enemy color of white, valuing the individual and disregarding moral laws.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: A white antagonist of the Kamigawa Cycle, obsessed with bringing his nation glory but losing sight of the individual.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A visionary white antagonist who commits atrocities she believes morally correct.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A visionary white antagonist who commits atrocities she believes morally correct.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of law enforcement, cited as a white antagonist.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Kaladesh's government, cited as a white antagonist.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of 'deal with the devil' law and religion, associated with white.

entities.name: Capennan Brokers
entities.description: A New Capenna family associated with white's law-based deal-making.
